messages:
alex_sales: Hey infra — NobleHealth asks for a short-term headroom uplift on their dedicated trial pool (pool-noble-03). They expect a big demo spike next Tues and want ~+50% capacity for ~48h starting Mon 2026-03-29. Can we do an autoscale override or a temporary reservation? Also need any pricing delta so sales can sign off.

jana_infra: Quick Qs — what GPU type & region? Do they want a firm reservation (billed as reserved hrs) or an autoscale policy bump (billed usage-hours)? Also who is the billing contact?

alex_sales: GPU: A100-80GB, region: us-west-2. Prefer autoscale override if non-disruptive; fallback to reservation if that's safer. Billing contact is procurement@noblehealth.com (cc: emma@noblehealth.com). Start 2026-03-29 08:00 UTC for ~48h. Can you confirm whether this needs exec approval?

lee_platform: We can do either. Two options: (1) Scheduled autoscale override (preferred) — non-disruptive, changes target pool capacity multiplier for a time window. (2) Short-term reservation — pins extra instances and guarantees capacity. Pricing: autoscale override = +30% effective unit rate during the window (because of burst premium), reservation = flat hourly reservation rate ~ $11/hr per A100-80 (estimate). I can give exact numbers once billing team confirms.

lee_platform: CLI to schedule override (example):

```
redwoodctl pools override create \
  --pool-id pool-noble-03 \
  --multiplier 1.5 \
  --start 2026-03-29T08:00:00Z \
  --end 2026-03-31T08:00:00Z \
  --reason "NobleHealth demo uplift"
```

lee_platform: That will show in console and we tag the change with `sales:poc` and `billing:procurement`. It won't evict running jobs; it's additive capacity.

sam_ops: Heads up — pool-noble-03 currently sits at 85% quota usage for us-west-2 in our quota tracker. I need to either approve an oversubscribe or we have to move some low-priority workloads. If you want us to approve, we need: PO#, billing contact, and SL. Also we require a short runbook that lists rollback steps + monitor checks.

jana_infra: Also note security/process: for dedicated POCs we need the customer to sign the temporary change AUP (third-party usage) — we usually include a line in the SOW. Can sales confirm SOW addendum?

alex_sales: Confirmed — I'll add the SOW addendum and send PO. PO# NH-PO-4821. Runbook: I'll draft and drop here in the morning. Please go ahead with a tentative autoscale override and hold final apply until I post the PO and runbook.

lee_platform: Roger. I created a draft override and left it in pending state. If you want to preview via API:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/pools/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"pool_id":"pool-noble-03","multiplier":1.5,"start":"2026-03-29T08:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-31T08:00:00Z","meta":{"tag":"sales:poc","po":"NH-PO-4821"}}'
```

lee_platform: Once PO + runbook posted, I can flip it from pending -> active. If quota approval is needed, @sam_ops will toggle.

sam_ops: I can sign-off on quota once we have PO and the runbook. Also will schedule a short pre-demo smoke (15m) on Mon morning to confirm scaling path and fallback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change draft created by lee_platform at 2026-03-20T15:12:09Z. Override ID: ov-9c7b2f. Status: pending.

alex_sales: sweet — thanks team. I'll post the runbook + PO later today. Please keep the draft override pending until I confirm. :thumbsup:
